zh-CN.title: 广场成为发言社区
items: 认证用户可以发布最多 140 字的发言
支持九张照片、照片位置与最长 60 秒语音
发言可设为公开或仅好友可见，未认证用户仍可浏览

en.title: The Square becomes a social feed
items: Verified users can publish statements of up to 140 characters
Add up to nine photos, photo locations, or a 60-second voice recording
Choose public or friends-only visibility while unverified users can still browse
